name: WordHunt
summary:
WordHunt is an interactive, fast-paced anagram-solving puzzle game built for Twitch livestreams. Viewers play along by typing their word guesses straight into the stream chat, with no external extensions or apps required. It works with the StreamElements bot, which is used to pay out points to the players.

Viewers collaborate as a team against a ticking clock to solve word pyramids, while the difficulty scales across levels with hidden letters, fake tiles, and firewalls. The game runs as a desktop app with an overlay for OBS and a streamer control panel, and the streamer can switch the game language on the fly or rotate between languages from one game to the next.
